question: Where should the fourteenth kalā named Vyācitā be placed with the mantra sarvebhyaḥ?
premises: The fourteenth kalā is named Vyācitā.
The specified location is the middle of the navel.
inference: One should place the fourteenth kalā named Vyācitā in the middle of the navel with sarvebhyaḥ.
plain_english: With ‘sarvebhyaḥ’, one should place the fourteenth kalā, named Vyācitā, in the middle of the navel.
